life_event: Born in Mobile, Alabama as James Clayton Vaughn, Jr.
Head Injury - Bicycle Accident
Father abandons family. Would return on occasion.
Stole copy of Mein Kampf
Dropped out of Murphy High School at the end of his junior year. Met Bobbie Louise Dorman (16) and marries her two weeks later. They divorce after
only four months of marriage.
Joined Arlington American Nazi Party
Becomes obsessed with Charles Manson’s plan for a race war
Begins insulting mixed-raced couples
Conviction for carrying a concealed weapon in Fairfax, VA
Joins National States Rights Party
Begins selling racist newspaper, The Thunderbolt
Joined KKK in Atlanta, GA (quit after a few months due to Klan’s lack of violence) Tailed a Black man with a white date, cornered them, and sprayed them with mace
(Montgomery County, MD)
Sent threating letter to newly elected President Jimmy Carter
Changed name to Joseph Paul Franklin
Joined Alabama National Guard
Commits first major bank robbery in Atlanta, GA
Bombs home of Jewish leader, Morris Amitay
Bombs of synagogue in Chattanooga, TN Goes to Madison, WI, robs a bank, plans to shoot Archie Simonson but instead shoots an
interracial couple, Alphonse Manning (23) and Toni Schwenn (23).
Robs a bank in Little Rock, AR
Drives to Dallas, TX buys a Remington 30.06
Robs a bank in Columbus, Ohio Kills Gerald Gordon (42) and wounds William Ash (30) in St. Louis, MO (Remington
700) Kills Johnny Brookshire (22) and wounds (paralyzed) his white girlfriend, Joy Williams
(23), in Atlanta, GA
Wounds/paralyzes Hustler magazine publisher Larry Flynt in Lawrenceville, GA (.44)
Wounds Gene Reeves (latter recovers) (.44)
Robs a bank in Louisville, KY
Robs a bank in Atlanta, GA Shoots an interracial couple at Pizza Hut – kills Bryant Tatum, and wounds his girlfriend,
Nancy Diane Hilton(18)
Robs a bank in Montgomery, AL
Returns to Alabama and meets Anita Carden (16) in an ice cream shop, they begin dating
Franklin and Anita get married in DeKalb County Courthouse (Atlanta, GA)
Shoots and kills Harold McIver (29) at Taco Bell in Doraville, GA (30.30)
Kills Raymond Taylor at Burger King in Falls Church, VA (30.30)
First offspring – Montgomery, AL Shoots and kills a mixed-race couple Jesse Taylor (42) and Marian Vera Bressette (31) in
Oklahoma City, OK Cheats on his wife and kills prostitute Mercedes Masters (15) after admission of
interracial relations
Kills Black man, Lawrence Reese (22), at fried chicken fast food restaurant Kills Leo Thomas Watkins (19) through plate glass of convenience store in Indianapolis
shopping mall (30.30)
Franklin and his wife Anita separate.
Kills hitchhiking student Rebecca Bergstorm in Mill Bluff State Park, WI
Shoots civil rights leader. Vernon Jordan. in Fort Wayne, IN
Kills cousins Darrell Layne (14) and Dante Evans Brown (13) in Cincinnati, OH
Kills Arthur Smothers (22) and Kathleen Mikula (16) in Johnstown, PA
Robs a bank in Burlington, NC Kills hitchhikers Nancy Santomero (19) and Vicki Durian (26) in Pocahontas, WV (.44
Ruger)
Kills Ted Fields (20) and David Martin (18) in Salt Lake City, UT (Marlin lever action)
Franklin is arrested in Florence, Kentucky and then escapes from the police department/
Franklin is recaptured in Lakeland, FL Extradited to Salt Lake City, UT and arraigned for the murders of Ted Fields and David
Martin. Federal Trial – convicted of violating the civil rights of Fields and Martin and sentenced
to two consecutive life sentences State Trial – convicted of killing Fields and Martin, sentenced to two more life sentence
due to hung jury regarding death penalty (attempted escape but recaptured) sent to Medical Center for Federal Prisoners in Springfield MI
Transferred to United States Penitentiary in Marion, IL to begin serving life sentences
Stabbed 15 times in the neck and abdomen by a group of African Americans
Federal Trial – found not guilty for violating the civil rights of Vernon Jordan
Partially confesses to the Larry Flynt shooting Confesses to shooting of Larry Flynt and bombing Morris Amitay’s house in Washington
DC Confesses to the murder of Rebecca Bergstrom; the murders of Santomero and Durian; Chattanooga synagogue bombing (tried in July and sentenced to 15-20yrs for bombing &
6-10yrs for possession of explosives), Rainbow murders, shooting Alphonse Manning (23) and Toni Schwenn (23) Convicted in Wisconsin of killing Manning and Schwenn. Sentenced to two consecutive
life sentences
Admits to Killing Ted Fields and David Martin in Salt Lake City, UT Jacob Beard is found guilty of two counts of 1st-Degree murder for the Rainbow murders
of Satomero and Durian although Franklin confessed to the murders
Franklin confesses to killing Gerald Gordon
Admits to shooting Vernon Jordan Tells Deborah Dixon, WKRC Cincinnati reporter, that he killed Santomero and Durian
because “They dated black people”
Found guilty of killing Gerald Gordon and sentenced to death

Admits to killing Raymond Taylor Admits to murdering Arthur Smothers and Kathleen Mikula. Later confesses to 04/13/1997 murdering Darrell Lane and Dante Evans Brown Found guilty of murdering Darrell Lane and Dante Evans Brown, sentenced to 40 years
to life in prison. Admits to killing William Tatum, pleads and receives two concurrent life sentences (one
for murder and one for robbery)
Confesses to killing prostitute Mercedes Masters and Harold McIver
Confesses to killing Johnny Brookshire in 1978
Jacob Beard is retried for the Rainbow murders and found not guilty US District Court requires Missouri to release or retry Franklin for the Gerald Gordon
murder Federal Judge puts the death penalty in Missouri on hold over concerns involving lethal
injection.
Federal Appellate Court overturns U.S. District Court decision U.S. Supreme Court decides that the current method of execution (lethal injection) is
constitutionally permissible US Supreme court refuses to hear Missouri lethal injection case Clemons v. Crawford,
lethal injection stands as permissible and Missouri attorney general states executions will begin again.
